spec_citations: WebUI may only expose flags owned and consumed by the monorepo.
Only applicable overrides should be offered; current limitations must not be misrepresented.
The operator must be able to launch with an explicit tier, not merely see a field.

findings.finding: Standalone Plan exposes --plan-review-model, but current monorepo Plan explicitly says that flag belongs to Iterate and standalone Plan reads only project config. WebUI is inventing an unsupported invocation.

The ordinary Iterate prompt claims Finalization and Execution overrides apply to this iterate. Monorepo Iterate consumes review/finalization/plan_review flags, but documents execution as having no live spawn in a standalone iterate; finalization is consumed by campaign-mode spawns. Execution is also absent from Iterate's declared Usage. These choices therefore over-promise behavior.

The E2E test proves read-only display and field visibility only. It never enables a tier, selects a value, verifies the generated slash command, or launches it. The central acceptance condition—explicit invocation without hand-writing the flag—remains unproved.
